QuestInfo.name: Tonight I Will Be Performing...
QuestInfo.0: Vicky looks... well, stylish probably isn't the right word, but she looks... something. Vincent winks at you. Ask him what's up.
QuestInfo.1: Vincent says Vicky still needs to decide on a song to perform. He's too shy to ask Vicky what song she wants, so ask her for him.
QuestInfo.2: You told Vicky she needs to figure out what song to sing.

0.0: Oh boy, oh boy, oh boy! Vicky liked it, didn't she?
0.1: Vicky's style is now complete. All that's left now is the actual singing. I have no idea what kind of song Vicky should sing. Can you help her choose a song for the audition?

yes.0: Yay, you're the best! Talk to Vicky and see how you can help.

no.0: Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?

1.0: Still choosing a song for the audition?

yes.0: Hmm, what song should I sing? Obviously I can perform any and all songs ever written with my perfectly beautiful voice.

npc.0: Go help Vicky choose a song.
